observed.caption: Sunlit brutalist concrete building with layered terraces and zigzagging ramps under a partly cloudy sky.
observed.description: A multi-level brutalist concrete building dominates the frame with cantilevered terraces, deep overhangs, and zigzagging exterior ramps with dark metal railings. The textured concrete surfaces show weathering and rust staining under the overhangs. Green potted plants sit on several terrace levels. Large glass windows are visible behind the upper balconies, with air conditioning units mounted under the concrete soffits. Blue pipes run beneath the lowest ramp. The sky in the upper left is bright with scattered clouds, casting strong daylight shadows across the structure. No people are clearly visible.
